business_value.problem: Multi-agent systems and persistent LLM instances bleed capital due to bloated context windows. Re-reading 50,000 tokens of chat history per API call costs exponential compute and degrades model accuracy.
business_value.solution: Treat agents as stateless functions. Extract their working memory into a highly compressed JSON payload, kill the session, and inject the payload into a new, blank session.
business_value.roi: Reduces token consumption for persistent memory by up to 99%. Grants multi-agent swarms infinite horizon memory at near-zero context cost.

step_1_extract.command: Inject meta-prompt instructing the LLM to serialize its active state.

step_2_terminate.command: Close the API session. (The Eden Protocol: Enforce TTL Mortality to prevent hallucination drift and token bloat).

step_3_inject.command: Open a new API session. Pass the JSON payload as the initial system prompt with the override command.
step_3_inject.override_command: You are a stateless processor. Load this JSON state to instantly resume the previous agent's exact operational context without history.

deployment_target: Enterprise AI developers, LangChain/AutoGen users, and startups burning VC capital on OpenAI API token costs.
